summary: The employer offers a written reference and to consider the person for other openings.
realLife: An HR article advises written job references, outplacement help for résumés and networking, and consideration for other company openings. It also notes the WARN Act requires 60 days' notice for a mass layoff.
sources: Workforce magazine, A humane approach to layoffs: https://workforce.com/news/a-humane-approach-to-layoffs
inGame: needs: references; other openings inside the same employer can ride on the jobs module's open positions. Scene: needs a producer for layoff-terms.

turns.summary: The employer lets the person go with no reference and no other openings.
turns.writesBack: The search is harder, and the tie to the employer ends cold.

turns.summary: The employer gives a written reference but says no other openings exist.
turns.writesBack: The person leaves with the reference, and the tie stays civil.

turns.summary: The employer places the person in another opening within the same business.
pulledBy: a large employer with open positions
turns.writesBack: The job record changes, and a promise to keep the person on is kept.
